reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 13 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked broad moustache without beard, separated cap emblems and visor embroidery, red collar patches/cross, pose, collar, backing, and source note rows/right tab.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note has THREE distinct mark rows: one separate dark horizontal dash above two rows of gray groups. The enlarged original has only TWO compact upper gray-mark rows. Remove the extra dash/row and restore only the source-scale two-row upper footprint and spacing, leaving the lower paper largely blank.

The source's small dark right-edge note tab is absent from the returned note's worn plain right edge. Restore the original compact dark tab and edge position/form without substituting a torn notch or new hardware.
entries.positive_observation: The dark olive-black cap retains gold piping/cord, dense gold visor embroidery and two separated front emblems, an upper badge and lower wreath/cockade. Covered hair, dark brows, no glasses, one broad dark-brown upper-lip moustache and a smooth chin without a beard remain. The near-frontal upright pose, direct gaze, one stern closed mouth, crop and strong visor shadow are retained. The dark olive uniform keeps gold shoulder accents, red pale/gold-detailed collar patches and one pale-edged dark throat cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The complete dark frame and opaque muted warm grey-olive backplate remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring; the note row addition and tab loss remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap-visor and collar embroidery, tiny throat-cross detail and note lettering are not reliably readable at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The returned three-versus-source-two row arrangement and missing tab are clearly resolved in native/enlarged comparisons, not inferred from glyphs or alpha values.
